title: Dwarf French Marigold - Plug Plants x 2 - Edible Flower - Great For Pollinators
description:
Dwarf French Marigold Plug Plants - Compact, Colourful, Easy to Grow 
 
 Grows 20-30cm (8-12 inches) tall - perfect for borders, containers, or small spaces. 
 
 
 Produces lots of bright yellow, orange, and red flowers (about 5cm/2in across). 
 
 
 Blooms from early summer until the first frost. 
 
 
 Attracts pollinators like bees and butterflies. 
 
 
 Good companion plant for vegetable gardens - helps repel pests naturally. 
 
 Low maintenance and drought-tolerant. 
 
 Thrives in full sun and well-drained soil.
